title: Envelope lettering transferred onto developed X-ray film
summary: Steve tells of Envelope lettering transferred onto developed X-ray film, about unspecified at Dr. builder's office, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: about 200 other X-rays. and um he showed it to me and the lettering from the outside of the envelope that the X-ray was in had somehow been transferred to the developed X-ray film.

plain: A scientist named Steve, who studies objects people say were implanted in their bodies by aliens, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about something a doctor he calls Dr. Builder showed him in his office. Among about 200 X-rays, he says, there was one where the printing on the outside of its paper envelope had somehow been copied onto the developed film inside. He offers it as a sign of some strange energy at work around these cases.
